title: 宝塚記念の後に・Weave a Story

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Please work… Please reach everyone…

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Fine Motion! What an incredible run!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Urk… ugh… Sniffle!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What are you crying for?!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: I-it's just… Fine Motion… She looks so happy! She looks like she's having so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: She was glowing so brightly! I don't think I'll ever forget this sight of her!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion! I'll never forget the way you ran today!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hi, Fine! U-um…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hey, Rob Roy!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hyah!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy right now. I think my wish actually reached someone's heart!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: On top of that, the race was so splendid! Everyone's intensity gave me chills. And—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Pardon? What is it? Did I say something funny?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Oh, u-um… I was just thinking that you're like a character from a story.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I've thought this for some time. You're like a main character that everyone loves.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: One from a tense, thrilling, heart-pounding story that leaves one with a smile on their face!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: People will want to pass down the story of how you ran today for generations.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad that I could be a part of it!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: A story… I see.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Let's make such an impact no that one ever forgets the name Fine Motion!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I understand now. Things have been in motion for some time.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: There's no need for me to be sad. After all…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm still running inside of everyone's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wow, what a great race. It seems like Fine Motion is over whatever was bothering her!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Right?! It felt great just watching her. I can't wait to see her run again!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: …Ugh, damn it. I don't feel even a byte of satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I suppose you couldn't defy fate either, in the end. As for me…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion returns to the waiting room with a cheerful smile on her face.
choice_data_list: What's got you in such a good mood?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Why, today's race, of course! What else could it be?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I yelled out "Don't you forget me!" and suddenly running felt better than ever before!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I don't yet know if I actually made an impact, but today has definitely been carved into my heart!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I want to run more races like this! There's still time, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Considering her achievements so far, I'd like for her to keep producing results in the G1 races, but…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That's it! I've just had a splendid idea.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I have a request. I want to run somewhere I haven't been before!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The further I travel, the more people can see me race and remember me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I want to leave my mark on the hearts of as many people as possible.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And to do that, I need to go to them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I understand her desire, but choosing a race isn't always so simple. I have to consider her current ability and that of her competition.
choice_data_list: Where were you thinking, by the way?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hmmm…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, ramen!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Each region has its own signature ramen, right? Shakur made an app for me so I can make a note of all the restaurants I'm interested in.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I haven't actually been able to go to many of them, but the places with the most are probably… Fukuoka or Hokkaido.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing "Hokkaido" reminds me that I recently heard a certain notable Umamusume has registered for a race in Sapporo. Fine Motion could make great memories there.
choice_data_list: Then, how about the Sapporo Kinen?
Then, how about the Sapporo Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oooh! Sapporo ramen! I'd love to go and try some! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That's not all, of course! I want the people of Hokkaido to see me run.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Off to Sapporo we go! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we set our sights on the Sapporo Kinen!
